title: A method and device for trajectory optimization based on federated learning in UAV relay network
assignee: University of Science and Technology Beijing USTB

pse.problem: The capacity optimization problem in a multi-UAV relay network
pse.solution_function: Optimizes the relay network capacity by constructing an optimization target model and using reinforcement learning algorithm for local model training to find optimal flight direction and transmit power for each UAV in each time slot, followed by federated learning for trajectory optimization.
pse.solution_structure: A multi-UAV system with local end devices, dividing the operating time into several equal time slots, assuming uniform speed during each time slot.
pse.solution_implementation: In each time slot, a reinforcement learning algorithm is used for local model training to find optimal flight direction and transmit power; federated learning is employed to achieve trajectory optimization in UAV relay networks.
pse.effect: Improves the communication performance of the network by optimizing relay network capacity while considering fuel consumption for a multi-UAV relay network
